description: This PHP class defines a Drupal migration process plugin named 'Download' that downloads files from remote HTTP(S) sources into the local file system, handling filename conflicts and streamlining the download process using Guzzle HTTP client.

classes.name: Download
classes.description: A Drupal migration process plugin class that handles downloading files from remote URLs into the local file system, with filename conflict resolution and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the download plugin with configuration, file system, and HTTP client services.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Performs the download operation: retrieves the source URL, determines the destination filename, streams the file content into the destination, and handles errors.
